description: The leftover ACME challenge TXT records of a DNS credential

supported.description: False when the provider has no confirmed TXT list and delete; nothing was asked of any outside service then

busy.description: A certbot run of this instance is going on: every item is in use and a delete is refused

key.description: Name and id (`set` for a provider that addresses the whole TXT set)

id.description: The provider's record id, null for a whole TXT set

values.description: The TXT values without the provider's quotes

age_seconds.description: Seconds since the provider's change time, null when the provider gives none

recent.description: Younger than 10 minutes: another ACME client may be using it

preselected.description: A known age over 1 hour and no run going on

items.description: The leftover TXT records, sorted by name

skipped_cnames.description: CNAME records at challenge names (delegations), left out

truncated.description: More than 500 items or 25 pages: the list is cut

error_i18n.description: `error.dns-cleanup-no-domains` when the credential has no domains
